answer: You started out as a QA Analyst back in January, living in regression suites and bug reports nobody wanted to read. In early June you signed the offer for Product Support Lead, which handed you four direct reports (and that inherited escalation backlog), and then in late November you jumped orgs internally to Technical Program Manager on the platform side — roadmap spreadsheets instead of angry customers. So in under a year you went from individual contributor to people manager to cross-team program owner, which is a pretty steep ramp.
